fields.sourced_today: Saint-Gobain Hexoloy SA 4-point flexural strength 380 MPa on a 3 x 4 x 45 mm bar. Compressive strength on the same sheets is 3900 MPa.
fields.weibull_note: Two-parameter Weibull at P_f = 0.001, m = 10, sigma_0 taken as 380 MPa, same volume as the bar. m = 10 is the seal-tube and structural-tile page. Sheet B-1003-2 lists 8 for standard SA and 12 for enhanced SA. This is not a volume-scaled tube allowable, and it is not a compression test.
fields.state: PENDING-025. 380 and 3900 exist on the datasheet. The 190 MPa figure is a calculation. This card carries 3900 MPa as 011b did. Using it as a tube allowable is an optimism. MAINLINE-025 owns the row.
